0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025CANCELNOTE_00168_GJUSANA_000_000
0.description: ...Hm? I can't very well dispose of something you don't have, now, can I?

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025CANCELNOTE_00168_GJUSANA_000_100
1.description: ...Really? Well, I suppose the moldy old book <hex:021A020203>was<hex:021A020103> bound for the furnace any─errr...I mean, it breaks my heart to see a piece of history treated like so many pages of soiled parchment, but who am I to argue with a customer?

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025CANCELNOTE_00168_00010
2.description: All progress within <hex:023111FF0A4576656E744974656D03E802020203> will be lost. Are you certain you wish to proceed?

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025CANCELNOTE_00168_GJUSANA_000_050
5.description: There. It's done. That particular bit of history will never bother you again. I hope you're happy now.

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON025CANCELNOTE_00168_SYSTEM_000_055
6.description: You throw away a book from the Trials of the Braves.
